name: What is the difference between a project estimate and a final quote?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a project estimate and a final quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: A project estimate provides an approximate cost range for your renovation, based on an initial understanding of the scope and your preliminary requirements. It’s an educated projection that gives you an idea of the investment needed. A final quote, however, is a precise, fixed price that AKN Design Group provides once all design plans, material selections, and project specifications are finalized and approved. This quote reflects the exact cost of completing your customized renovation project, ensuring transparency and accountability. The transition from estimate to quote occurs as we progress through our detailed design-build planning phases, providing a single point of coordination for a managed process.
acceptedAnswer.description: A project estimate is an approximate cost range, while a final quote is a precise, fixed price issued once all design plans and specifications are finalized and approved.
